annuler_attribution_fenetre: Undo the allocation for this window?
annuler_attribution_supprime_conges_cree: Undo the allocation: deletes the leave created and tells the employees
apercu_sera_attribue_aucun_conge: Preview of what will be allocated. No leave is created until you run the real allocation.
aucun_collegue_n_apos_conge: No colleague has approved leave this month.
aucun_conge_approuve_mois: No leave approved for this month
aucune_absence_ni_preference_mois: No absence and no preference this month
aucune_preference_soumise_fenetre: No preference submitted in this window.
contester_attribution_motif_requis: Dispute this allocation (a reason is required)
creez_fenetre_lancer_cycle_selection: Create a window to start a selection cycle (summer 2026 vacation, say). Employees submit their preferences before the closing date.
disponible_fois_fenetre_fermee: Available once the window is closed
employes_soumettent_leurs_preferences_en: Employees submit their preferences between the submission dates; you run the allocation afterwards.
jusqu_apos_3_choix_rang: Up to 3 choices. Rank 1 is your favourite. The allocation goes by seniority.
lancer_attribution_finale_irreversible: Run the final allocation (cannot be undone)
lancer_maintenant_attribution_irreversib: Run the allocation now (cannot be undone)
leaverequest_approuvees_seront_crees_cha: An approved leave request is created for every granted preference. This cannot be undone.
modifiez_filtres_videz_recherche: Change the filters or clear the search.
n_fenetres_ouvertes: {count, plural, one {# window opened} other {# windows opened}}
ouvrir_n_brouillons: Open {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}?
periode_soumission_fermee_rh_va: The submission period is closed. HR runs the allocation shortly.
plus_aucun_employe_ne_pourra: No employee can submit preferences any more. HR is told to run the allocation.
publier_fenetre_employes_seront_notifies: Publish the window — the employees are told
rh_revise_preferences_avant_attribution: HR reviews the preferences before the final allocation.
survolez_cellule_voir_detail_faites: Hover a cell to see the detail. Scroll sideways if you need to.
toutes_fenetres_brouillon_passeront_etat: Every draft window moves to Open. Every active employee is told.
toutes_preferences_soumises_seront_perdu: Every submitted preference is lost. This is final.
utilisez_fleches_naviguer_vers_autres: Use the arrows to move to the other months of the window.
visualisez_prend_deja_vacances_preferenc: See who is already on vacation and which preferences are in, so you avoid the clashes.
voir_conge_cree_cet_employe: See the leave created for this employee
voir_prend_conge_periode_noms: See who is off during this period (names + anonymous)
vous_etes_parmi_premiers_consulter: You are among the first to look at this window.
vous_n_apos_avez_pas: You have not submitted preferences for this window.
windows_view_en_haut_pour_stopper_les_so: at the top to stop submissions and unlock allocation, or wait for the automatic closing date.
windows_view_les_boutons_accorder_refuse: The Grant/Refuse buttons stay disabled until the submission period is closed (to keep it fair between employees).
workflow_brouillon_gt_ouverte_employes: Workflow: draft -> open (employees submit) -> closed -> allocation -> archived
